habitat: The cane toad is native to the Americas, and its range stretches from theRio Grande ValleyinSouth Texasto the centralAmazonand southeasternPeru, and some of the continental islands nearVenezuela(such asTrinidadandTobago).[70][71]This area encompasses bothtropicalandsemiaridenvironments. The density of the cane toad is significantly lower within its native distribution than in places where it has been introduced. In South America, the density was recorded to be 20 adults per100m (110yd)of shoreline, 1 to 2% of the density in Australia.[72]
